morphology.pattern_note: 外来人名，整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。规范书写首字母大写；具体读音依姓名持有人的语言和自我介绍确定，故不填唯一 IPA。没有可据此建立的马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 斯特凡：男性名字，在马来语文本中用作人名专有名词。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name used as a proper noun in Malay discourse.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi individu, lazimnya lelaki, yang ditulis Stefan.
senses.nuances: 属于 kata nama khas，不是表示普通事物的马来语通名。输入未提供 DBP 释义，本释义为编写说明，不冒称官方原文；status 因此标为 proper_name。排名沿用输入语料，不能解释为普通马来语词汇的通用频率。下列组合为用法示例，未经频次验证。姓名及多语言读音参见 [Behind the Name：Stefan](https://www.behindthename.com/name/stefan)。

etymology.historical_story: Stefan belongs to the international family of Stephen, ultimately tracing to Greek Stephanos, meaning a crown or wreath. Early Christian traditions helped spread this name family across Europe, where different languages developed distinct forms and pronunciations. In Malay discourse, Stefan identifies a person; its historical association with a crown does not become a Malay dictionary meaning. Sources: [Stefan](https://www.behindthename.com/name/stefan), [Stephen](https://www.behindthename.com/name/stephen).
